title: Finger Drumming Path
subtitle: MPC finger drumming to about Melodics stage 10, beat making woven in.
benchmark: Melodics Stage 10 of 15 (pads); about Drumeo Method level 5 and Rockschool Drums Grade 4 to 5 grooves, on fingers

levels.title: First beats
levels.goal: A backbeat in time with both hands, eighth hats, a crash on one and four-bar phrases. About Melodics stage 1 to 2.
levels.adds: Split hands, counting 1 & 2 &, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4, Wait mode, play-along.

steps.title: Set up the pads
steps.setup: Pads, Dynamics: calibrate soft and loud on the MPC once, then Even (16 hits at one level). Full Level off.
steps.done: Calibration saved; 16 even hits with 80% inside one velocity band.

steps.title: First beat, no clock
steps.setup: Grooves: basic rock in Wait mode (no click, each note waits for its pads). Wait mode is practice; a Check run at any tempo counts.
steps.done: 4 bars with no wrong pad, on two days.

steps.title: First beat in time
steps.setup: Grooves: basic rock at 70, then 90.
steps.done: Pass at 90, 3 runs, on two days.

steps.done: Mean error 50 ms or less at 90.

steps.done: Within 3 BPM after the click drops, on two days.

steps.title: Crash on one, first fill
steps.setup: Grooves: shave and a haircut tag, then the one-beat fill and landing.
steps.done: Each passes at 80 with the landing crash inside the good window.

steps.title: First whole song
steps.setup: Song Studio with a shelf song's drum part on the pads, We Will Rock You or any other: Wait mode, then Performance at 80% speed.
steps.done: One shelf song end to end at 80% speed, 85% of notes good.

steps.title: Improvise over a loop
steps.setup: A chosen loop under Improvise; raw and half-quantised playback reviewed.

steps.title: Live beat, 4 bars
steps.setup: Create, Play it live: a 4-bar beat with swing 56 and Note Repeat on a held pad, built in passes in under 5 minutes. Then 16 bars of fills over it; Improvise plays its own loops, not yours, so the fills are not judged here.
steps.done: Built in under 5 minutes, then 16 bars of fills over it.

steps.title: Faded feedback
steps.setup: Grooves in Check with Feedback set to fade: the notes and judgements for two plays, then summary only; the plays after the fade are graded. Five grooves you know.

steps.title: The set
steps.setup: Song form, Write a new piece: an intro, 3 grooves from 3 levels, a chop section on the slices, a solo over a loop and an end (a fill or a stop), each with its bars and level. Only a piece in that shape lasting 3 to 5 minutes at the run's tempo counts. Record the take in Record if you want to keep the audio.
steps.done: One take, 3 to 5 minutes, most sections passed.
